newsitem.title: USA: Syncor expands pact from Dupont Merck.
newsitem.headline: Syncor expands pact from Dupont Merck.

text.p: Syncor International Corp said Thursday it expanded its long-term supply and distribution agreement with the DuPont Merck Pharmaceutical Co, to include new products recently launched by DuPont Merck.

The amended agreement will add to Syncor's distribution agreement the drugs Quadramet, for the relief of pain from metastatic bone cancer; and Miraluma, to diagnose breast leasions following abnormal mammograms.

Other changes to the agreement will provide Syncor with incremental earnings in excess of $5 million for the rest of the calendar year. Syncor said it expects this change to add $0.30 per share to its 1997 earnings, and about $0.10 per share in 1998.
Syncor, which compounds and dispenses radiopharmaceuticals in patient specific doses, entered a long-term distribution agreement with DuPont Merck, its principal supplier, in 1993.
